scenes.name: wasted-first-impression
scenes.transcript: Your website is your first impression. Most businesses waste it.
scenes.visualDescription: Browser window loads a dull generic site; spinner stalls; page renders flat; cursor arrives, hovers, bounces away top-right; scene dims to near-black on impact.

soundEffects.trigger: cursor bounces away and scene dims

scenes.name: three-second-exit
scenes.transcript: Slow pages. Broken layouts. Visitors leave in three seconds.
scenes.visualDescription: Site breaks apart in three breakages synced to countdown digits 3-2-1, at zero everything slides off leaving dark canvas.

scenes.name: orbit-builds-better
scenes.transcript: Orbit Web Designs builds fast, modern websites that turn visitors into customers.
scenes.visualDescription: Fresh browser window snaps together: nav, hero, two feature cards, CTA; speed badge stamps 98; cursor glides to CTA, clicks; conversion card with green check slides up.

scenes.name: design-speed-seo
scenes.transcript: Design, speed, SEO - done right, from Nairobi to the world.
scenes.visualDescription: Three amber tiles rise one at a time: DESIGN fans type specimens, SPEED sweeps gauge needle high, SEO climbs rank chips from 8 to 1; globe pulse expands outward from Nairobi.

scenes.name: orbit-outro
scenes.transcript: Orbit Web Designs. Your brand, in motion. Visit orbitwebdesigns.co.ke today.
scenes.visualDescription: Dark starfield; DESIGN, SPEED, SEO tiles orbit a bright center, spiral inward and merge into the ORBIT wordmark wrapped by an orbital ring; URL types out beneath; lockup holds.
